gen-dafont-nordic-fs-hoover: Hoover is a sturdy text serif with a generous opening in the e and short, compressed ascenders, refined without going fragile. Nordic stays tight and ancient above it, every stroke one rope-like weight, and the body keeps a longer read moving.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-trench-slab: Trench Slab sits low and dignified, its capitals barely rising above the lowercase. But Nordic, with its pressed-leaf openings and brush-dab spacing, supplies the ancient weight, so a long read feels steady rather than heavy.
gen-dafont-nulshock-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded and tall in the lowercase, a serif that fills the line with sturdy bodies. Nulshock stretches wide and outlined above it, technical where the body is warm.
gen-dafont-nulshock-fs-trench-slab: Nulshock stretches out, wide and technical. Every curve carries the thickness of a straight stem, while Trench Slab underneath stays low, with capitals hugging the lowercase; try the heading a few sizes up.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-literata: Classic and commanding, Oldtimer rounds its letters like open parentheses with no swell on the downstrokes. And Literata follows with sturdy thin lines and only mild contrast, so a long page stays bookish and unhurried.
gen-dafont-oldtimer-fs-sentient: Round, open parentheses of letters up top, with no weight shift along any curve, then pinched, closed-in forms below. Sentient lets a longer read flow gently, its bowls swelling just a touch.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-erode: Origami looks like a sign-painter's single brush stroke at constant width, with a lowercase mass like poured lead. Erode makes a long read feel settled, its broad apertures and restrained swells moving the eye along.
gen-dafont-origami-fs-trench-slab: Poured-lead lowercase, drawn in one constant brush stroke, gives Origami its unusual look. But Trench Slab brings a dignified, low profile below it, so a long read feels refined and steady.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-bespoke-slab: Outrun Future keeps its letters far apart, each one a constant-width outline you could trace with a finger. Bespoke Slab then carries a long read with tall, grounded lowercase bodies and a refined serif temperament.
gen-dafont-outrun-future-fs-erode: Authoritative, with a synthwave edge drawn in one pen tip. Erode takes over below, its soft thick-thin traces and broad apertures making a long read feel editorial and dignified.
